purpose: City-specific official registry/cadastre and safe anonymous parcel-geometry discovery.
assessment: The city-published Office of the Assessor layer yielded one Polygon at the exact WUP point. The bounded request selected only object_id, parcel_number and geometry. No other property data was requested, accessed, or retained. The result supports sample-level geometry availability only; runtime and citywide coverage remain unassessed.
registryAssessment: The City of Detroit Open Data Portal publishes an Office of the Assessor parcel layer. Its polygon schema provides safe keys object_id and parcel_number. A bounded exact WUP-point query returned one polygon using only those two fields plus geometry; no owner, address or assessment values were requested or retained.

rootRuntimeReview.reason: 200 valid distinct Detroit Office of the Assessor current parcel polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP locator. Complete viewports, ten forced three-row pages, all 200 fresh native parcel_number reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed in 32 public requests. Native parcel numbers retain their dots, hyphens and combined-lot suffixes exactly; object_id is transport paging identity only. Only these two schema-verified safe identifiers and full geometry are queried or retained. Independent metric EPSG:32617 GEOS found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The exact WUP point lies in source geometry. Wider municipal completeness, title, survey accuracy and long-term key continuity remain unverified.
